Backend pytest 62/62 pass (added 10 new v4 tests): wilayah cascading proxy (provinsi 34 items, kota by 32, kecamatan by 3271), contract DOCX download 200 with correct MIME + Content-Disposition + 201KB payload (403 for wrong kontak), extension already open_ended (8U8U) → 400 'sudah dikonfirmasi', extension wrong contact → 403, public schedule-request delivery on active order (AIQX) rejected 400, admin re-schedule delivery after delivery done (AIQX active) → 400 'Pengiriman telah selesai dilakukan', rental payload v4 missing provinsi → 422. Legacy suite still passes: 3-role auth, tracking, admin CRUD/billings/notifications, cron auth+idempotent, courier RBAC, schedule role guard. Frontend: /tracking route (NOT /lacak) verified end-to-end for E2E order CLM-20260817-8U8U — timeline shows all v4 statuses, kontrak-signed badge + PDF note visible, WA admin buttons resolve to https://wa.me/6285695965790 and https://wa.me/6281232576420 exactly as specified, extension-active badge shown (order is open_ended). Frontend /sewa wilayah cascading verified in UI: DKI Jakarta → 6 kota → 2 kecamatan → 3 kelurahan populated correctly, downstream selects enable only after parent picked. Logo CollerMind renders in header + footer.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_public.py `_wilayah` catches ALL upstream errors then falls back to cache only if cache exists; if cache miss + emsifa hiccup during first use, user sees 503 with no retry. Consider serving stale-on-error via a longer TTL and background refresh.

routes_cron.py `run_billing_cycle` open-ended block inserts a new invoice inside a broad try/except but does not push a status_history entry or notify_event when the new invoice is created, so customers won't get notified about the upcoming perpanjangan invoice until it transitions to 'issued' on the next bill_date. Confirm this is desired.

routes_tech.py `submit_work` reads `request.form()` inside the `installation` branch AFTER FastAPI already parsed Form(...) params; on some ASGI servers this can raise 'Stream consumed'. Consider passing multi-file uploads via a `List[UploadFile] = File([])` param instead of manual form parsing for reliability.
